members.name: Agent Buzz
members.description: Curated AI-agent tweets, clustered into narratives with insight summaries

members.name: builder-map
members.description: Weekly map of who's building on top of watched repos — forks, third-party ecosystem repos, builder announcements. Answers the "who's building on top" question.

members.name: Engagement Act
members.description: Turn flagged engagement opportunities into ready-to-post replies — read recent logs, draft specific responses, send as copy-paste-ready output

members.name: Farcaster Digest
members.description: Clustered, signal-scored digest of Farcaster casts with conversation-shape lead and insight-first editorial notes

members.name: Fetch Tweets
members.description: Search X/Twitter for tweets about a token, keyword, username, or topic — clustered by sub-narrative

members.name: Last 30 Days
members.description: Cross-platform social research — narrative-first intelligence on what people are saying about a topic across Reddit, X, HN, Polymarket, and the web over the last 30 days

members.name: List Digest
members.description: Cross-list narrative resonance + signal-scored top tweets from tracked X lists in the past 24 hours

members.name: Refresh X
members.description: Fetch a tracked X/Twitter account's latest tweets, cluster them, and save a decision-ready gist to memory

members.name: Remix Tweets
members.description: Fetch ~30 older tweets, pre-filter for remixability, then produce 10 new rephrased versions across diverse strategies with post-write quality gates

members.name: Reply Maker
members.description: Generate two reply options for 5 tweets from tracked X accounts or topics

members.name: Telegram Digest
members.description: Cross-channel digest of public Telegram posts — ranked by signal, clustered by narrative, not by channel

members.name: Thread Formatter
members.description: Score the day's events from memory/logs and format the top one as a 5-tweet thread ready to paste

members.name: Tweet Digest
members.description: Account-based digest of recent tweets from tracked X/Twitter accounts. Sibling to fetch-tweets (keyword) and tweet-roundup (topic).

members.name: Tweet Roundup
members.description: Gist of the latest tweets on configurable topics

members.name: Write Tweet
members.description: Generate 10 tweet drafts across 5 size tiers (2 variations each) on a topic from today's outputs

members.name: Protocol Monitor (x402 default)
members.description: Weekly tracker for a configured protocol's ecosystem velocity — new GitHub integrations, npm adoption, notable announcements. Defaults to x402; operators swap in their own protocol via memory/topics/tracked-protocol.md.
